title: State of the Feed — Week of August 3–9, 2026
content_html:
The aggregator processed 7,758 articles across six runs this week, delivering 516 quality articles after filtering. The ai-tech category dominated with 97 articles, followed by news (150) and wellness (59), while niche categories like outdoors (1) and design (6) saw minimal volume. The dimensional scoring model weighted relevance at 0.55, quality at 0.25, and local content at 0.20, resulting in a mean noise-to-signal ratio of 1.84 across the pipeline—within normal operating range at the lower end of the observed variation (1.21–2.25).

Forty-four new feeds were integrated this week, expanding coverage in architecture and design (Dezeen, ArchDaily, Architizer), homesteading and agriculture (Hobby Farms, Permaculture Research Institute, Small Farm Canada), health and wellness (Being Patient, KFF Health News, Harvard Health Blog), and general interest publications (The New Yorker, The Atlantic, Vox, Mother Jones). Three feeds reported errors: Mother Earth News, Old House Journal, and LoRaMeshDevices.

Top discovery candidates for potential inclusion scored 73.7 to 81.2: Regional News Archives - Williams Lake Tribune (81.2), globalnews.ca (74.1), and Bambu Lab Blog (73.7).
